findings: The current 128-simulation PUCT configuration used roughly one ninth of the reference engines total search time.
The new value model has useful teacher-label signal on the fixed 2048-position validation diagnostic; this is not playing-strength proof.
With identical new weights, PUCT-128 repeated all 34 observed avoidable mate-in-one blunders, full-time PUCT repeated 26, and alpha-beta repeated zero.
These selected tactical positions establish a search weakness, not a fresh match win rate or a diagnosis of every lost game.
recommended_next_step: Freeze a separate same-search comparison using the original alpha-beta for both neural evaluators before any additional paid training.
